Existing code chunks all contour segments; this is not a 128-segment total geometry cap

existingSceneAndPresentationGates.supportedToday: Static supplied geometry records, per-stage area/front references, existing temporal states; one presentation territory color per state
existingSceneAndPresentationGates.unsupportedToday: No admitted source-bound dense polygon timeline reference or faction-per-area palette in current formal contract. Adding arbitrary fields to mobile JSON does not connect a consumer and may be rejected or normalized away.
existingSceneAndPresentationGates.paletteConstraint: Existing territoryColors has at most 8 state IDs and RGBA alpha in [0.08,0.6]; it does not distinguish two owners in the same state.

minimalExistingPrivateDataTransport.finding: Existing official session already supports arbitrary registered static resources, including application/json. No new HTTP server, GPU renderer or texture-lease extension is needed for a bounded control dataset.
minimalExistingPrivateDataTransport.validation: readPinnedServerFile enforces registry-owned file path, byte count/hash, no-follow/ownership and immutable read checks; exact registered URL bytes are served on existing loopback session GET
minimalExistingPrivateDataTransport.publicBoundary: Request data may select only an explicitly admitted registration/data ID and hash. It must not authorize arbitrary local paths, remote URLs, registry entries or new data through a Boolean.
minimalExistingPrivateDataTransport.browserPayload: Use a small compiled ref containing registered relative URL, bytes, SHA256, source interval/frame mapping and domain/source IDs. Browser loader must verify fetched bytes and source contract before evaluation. Never expose private sourcePath in mobile JSON or public runtime diagnostics.
minimalExistingPrivateDataTransport.leaseAlternativeNotNeeded: candidate_asset_lease.mjs currently has strict png,textureDescriptor,window entries; preserve that texture path and use existing record.resources static service instead.
minimalExistingPrivateDataTransport.registrationRebindRequired: New input semantic/chunk hashes and changed module hashes require newly qualified registry registrations, payload/proof/activation pins and private-package receipt; preserve old registrations/package/image. Existing old-input registrations cannot be reused merely by swapping dataset bytes.

minimalRuntimeRoute.historicalFacts: Add an explicit optional versioned control_timeline_ref to the facts/compiled Scene contract and preserve/validate it through normalization. Keep palette/opacity as presentation fields. Do not disguise changed territorial facts as styling only.
minimalRuntimeRoute.compiler: Resolve source-bound dataset identity and frame mapping at admission; produce a small existing-engine-plan binding that identifies this qualified timeline. Do not expand all 600 source samples into every Scene, runtime request or proof.
minimalRuntimeRoute.evaluator: A generic bounded helper reads the admitted dataset, performs deterministic random-access local-frame to source-frame mapping, returns current owner Polygon/MultiPolygon geometries and the same-frame front/provenance. Native source morph segment data may be retained compactly if its evaluator and source correspondence are independently qualified.
minimalRuntimeRoute.drawOwner: Call existing createAreaOverlayPass with controls.areas containing current-frame geometry, alpha=1 and coverage=1, selecting a separate existing pass/style per owner color. coverage<1 creates radial reveal and is not historical advance.
minimalRuntimeRoute.frontOwner: Existing drawLine requires a fresh linePrimitive whose projected coordinates match the current geographic front; build it with the existing line owner for the current camera. Do not reuse stale projections. Polygon contour already derives from the drawn geometry, with existing protected boundary/label masks.
minimalRuntimeRoute.diagnostics: For the new mode, record dataset SHA256, evaluated global/local/source frame, owner IDs, geometry hashes, bounds/counts and source truth kind. Do not put the entire timeline in each FRAME_EVIDENCE row. Preserve legacy evidence behavior unless a specific changed-mode proof schema is added.
preservedOwners: native triangulateRegion and polygon hole support

sizeDecision.meaning: With present input bytes, a 300-frame inline timeline averaging more than about 13.2 KB/frame already exceeds mobile 4 MiB, before new structure/provenance/pretty printing. Actual DVA packet size was not available to this audit; no dataset-size PASS is claimed.
sizeDecision.preferred: Store dense frame geometry once as a bounded registered static dataset, or keep compact source-native morph endpoints/ratio mappings. Mobile files carry only explicit source-bound references and presentation. Select only needed part/chunk slice in a candidate session if actual static totals require it.
requiredBeforeBuild: Measure each final mobile file and actual POST/Node wrapper bytes
Measure registry, prepared timeline record and each candidate session static/module totals
Measure max evaluated polygon triangles and protection geometry counts
Verify no complete timeline repetition in frame diagnostics
Hash and qualify frame mapping, cross-PART boundary and random access without a new GPU run
Count all source-derived evaluated polygon coordinates (4096 per geometry) and any legacy front-line records (129 per record); retain exact admitted boundaries without silent geometric simplification
